case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO. 3615 OF 2023 (ARISING OUT OF SLP(C) NO. 8493 OF 2021) WITH CIVIL APPEAL NO. ______ OF 2023 (ARISING OUT OF SLP(C) NO. 16778 OF 2021)
summary: Power Purchase Agreement dispute; arbitral award confirming variable fuel charges under PPA; Government's challenge to award under Section 34; High Court interference improper in Section 37 appeal; award upheld for variable charges on alternate fuel, downrating of plant, and nettling-out principle; payment obligations affirmed; SLPs converted to Civil Appeals.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment set aside; arbitral award upheld in entirety.
